news.title: Key talking points from Bompastor and Bronze ahead of Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 皇家社会之前邦帕斯托和青铜的关键谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor and Lucy Bronze faced the media at Cobham this afternoon ahead of our Women's Champions League qualifier clash against Real Sociedad on Tuesday night. The Blues are looking to gain an advantage in the first leg at home in our maiden match at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, before heading to Spain for the return leg on 2 September. Tickets are still available for Wednesday's game, and you can purchase them here. Alongside the latest injury news provided by Bompastor, here is a rundown of the other major talking points from today's press conference... Sonia Bompastor: It will be a strong test. Real Sociedad finished third in the Liga F. They are a Spanish team, so they have a really strong philosophy in possession, but they have a lot of quality out of possession as well. We know everything about them now, and we prepared for the game well. But the game tomorrow will also be about us, and I'm confident with the quality we have shown during pre-season. Lucy Bronze: I remember playing against Real Sociedad in Liga F when I was at Barcelona, and they were always a good team. They always played good football. We had good results against them, but I always remember them being a really good team, something that me and Keira (Walsh) both spoke about recently. I actually watched the game last year when they were playing against Barca. They defended really well, which isn't the easiest thing to do against Barca when they were continually attacking. SB: Pre-season has been really good. We have worked really hard with a lot of intensity in training sessions. We travelled all over the world, and it was a really good opportunity for the squad to be together and for us to get to know each other better. Since we came back, we also recovered really well from the travel, but we got back to business, and I think we are in a really good place for the game tomorrow. LB: We've got a lot of young, talented players at Chelsea, a lot of eager players who are keen to learn and to listen. Sometimes they get things wrong, but they try really hard, and it's exciting to be part of the club and to see so many players grow, develop and improve every day. I think that's the exciting part of this team this year: the youth and the exuberance we will have on the pitch. LB: I think it's fun. We like playing against teams from different countries. The league phase last year was different, and I guess this is just another difference, but we're very much focused on this game. We know it's very important for us to win tomorrow, especially playing at home. We don't take anything for granted. We know what a good team they are. I think having more games this year is exciting for us as Chelsea, and being in a different position just allows you to adapt and learn new things about the team. LB: People forget how much spotlight was put on her from a very young age. But I think in the team at Chelsea, you can see she feels comfortable. She's grown as a player. She's grown as a person. You can see that she's grown so many connections with all of the team. We all know that when LJ is flowing, there's nobody in the world that can stop her. So it's nice to see that she's growing a lot. SB: As a coach, I'm someone who really cares about the players, but as a human, I also care about the humans and the person. So I think in this environment, I always try my best to encourage the players to be themselves and to express themselves. It's okay for us to be vulnerable sometimes. We spend so much time together, so I'm happy with what Lucy said in terms of allowing people to be themselves, in terms of vulnerability, but also when they are showing confidence, it's something good. LB: Pre-season has gone so well. The new signings are fitting in really well too. It just feels like we're on a fresh start. We have kind of put a line in the sand from last season, and moving forward to be even bigger and better than Chelsea's ever been. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 今天下午，索尼娅·邦帕斯托和露西·青铜在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，准备周二晚上与皇家社会队进行女子冠军联赛预选赛。蓝军希望在樱桃红唱片体育场举行的首回合主场比赛中获得优势，然后于 9 月 2 日前往西班牙进行第二回合比赛。周三比赛的门票仍然有售，您可以在这里购买。除了 Bompastor 提供的最新伤病消息外，这里还概述了今天新闻发布会上的其他主要话题…… Sonia Bompastor：这将是一次强有力的考验。皇家社会队在西甲联赛中排名第三。他们是一支西班牙球队，因此他们在控球方面拥有很强的理念，但他们在控球方面也有很多实力。我们现在已经了解了他们的一切，并且我们为比赛做好了充分的准备。但明天的比赛也将是我们的比赛，我对我们在季前赛中表现出的实力充满信心。露西·布朗兹：我记得当我在巴塞罗那时，在联赛中对阵皇家社会队，他们一直是一支优秀的球队。他们总是踢出漂亮的足球。我们在对阵他们的比赛中取得了不错的成绩，但我一直记得他们是一支非常优秀的球队，这是我和凯拉（沃尔什）最近都谈到的。事实上，我去年就看过他们对阵巴萨的比赛。他们的防守非常好，当巴萨不断进攻时，这并不是最容易做到的事情。 SB：季前赛真的很棒。我们在训练中非常努力，强度很大。我们走遍了世界各地，这对球队来说是一个很好的机会，让我们能够更好地了解彼此。自从我们回来后，我们也从旅行中恢复得很好，但我们又回到了正事，我认为我们对于明天的比赛处于一个非常好的状态。 LB：我们切尔西有很多年轻、有才华的球员，很多渴望学习和倾听的球员。有时他们会犯错，但他们真的很努力，成为俱乐部的一员并看到这么多球员每天都在成长、发展和提高，这真是令人兴奋。我认为这就是今年这支球队令人兴奋的部分：我们在球场上将充满青春和活力。 LB：我觉得这很有趣。我们喜欢与来自不同国家的球队比赛。去年的联赛阶段有所不同，我想这只是另一个不同，但我们非常关注这场比赛。我们知道明天的胜利对我们来说非常重要，尤其是在主场比赛。我们不认为任何事情是理所当然的。我们知道他们是一支多么优秀的团队。我认为今年有更多的比赛对我们切尔西来说是令人兴奋的，处于不同的位置只会让你适应和了解球队的新事物。 LB：人们忘记了她从很小的时候起就受到了多少关注。但我认为在切尔西的球队中，你可以看到她感觉很舒服。作为一名球员，她已经成长了。她作为一个人已经成长了。您可以看到她与整个团队建立了如此多的联系。我们都知道，当LJ流动时，世界上没有人可以阻止她。所以很高兴看到她成长了很多。 SB：作为一名教练，我是一个真正关心球员的人，但作为一个人，我也关心人类和人。所以我觉得在这样的环境下，我总是尽力鼓励选手们做自己，表达自己。有时我们感到脆弱是没关系的。我们花了很多时间在一起，所以我很高兴露西所说的，让人们做自己，在脆弱方面，而且当他们表现出自信时，这是一件好事。 LB：季前赛进展顺利。新签约的球员也非常适合。感觉就像我们有了一个新的开始。从上个赛季开始，我们已经划定了界限，并继续前进，变得比切尔西以往任何时候都更大、更好。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中欢迎 CFCW 来到我们位于斯坦福桥的新家！

news.title: Analysis: How POTM Cole Palmer inspired Blues to victory
news.title_zh: 分析：POTM 科尔·帕尔默如何激励蓝军取得胜利
news.body_en: We detail the pivotal role Cole Palmer played in helping the Blues get our Premier League campaign up and running with a victory at Fulham. Our No10 was at his very best at Craven Cottage. Palmer assisted and scored a goal in the same Premier League game for the first time since February’s draw with Leeds United, with his cute finish early in the second half ultimately settling the contest. That was one of a game-high five attempts Palmer registered against Fulham, while he also led the way for successful dribbles (five), duels won (10), touches in the opposition box (nine) and fouls won (three). All those statistics point to the intent and confidence with which Palmer played. His nine attempted take-ons showed just how keen he was to beat his man, with one twisting and turning run in the second half nearly culminating in a special solo strike. Xabi Alonso’s system, using Palmer in a pocket alongside Morgan Rogers and off Joao Pedro, helped our No10 receive the ball. He spent more time in possession than every Chelsea outfielder bar Reece James, Josh Acheampong and Morgan Lacroix. Palmer was consistently effective when he had the ball at his feet. His assist for Joao Pedro’s record-breaking goal – the fastest ever scored in the Premier League on an opening weekend – was one of three key passes Palmer played, a figure bettered only by Rogers’ five. In total, Palmer completed 88 per cent of his passes, significantly higher than the team average of 82 per cent. A significant proportion (14) were played in the final third, too, highlighting his willingness to take risks. The weight and direction of Palmer’s passes were pivotal to our first and second goals, while his own strike showed his pinpoint accuracy in front of goal. The angle was narrow, so he aimed to slip the ball through Bernd Leno’s legs – and succeeded. Palmer wasn’t afraid to do his defensive work, either. He won two tackles and recovered possession seven times, including on three occasions in the final third. Those high turnovers proved instrumental for our first two goals of the night. Palmer was ably assisted by Joao Pedro and Rogers. That trio played 20 passes between them and showed signs of an understanding that bodes very well for the future – as does Palmer’s elite display. Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 我们详细介绍了科尔·帕尔默在帮助蓝军启动并在富勒姆取得胜利的英超联赛中所发挥的关键作用。我们的 10 号在 Craven Cottage 处于最佳状态。自二月份战平利兹联以来，帕尔默首次在同一场英超比赛中助攻并进球，他在下半场早些时候的可爱射门最终锁定了比赛。这是帕尔默在对阵富勒姆的比赛中全场最高的五次射门之一，同时他还在成功带球（五次）、对抗胜利（十次）、对方禁区触球（九次）和犯规获胜（三次）方面领先。所有这些统计数据都表明了帕尔默打球的意图和信心。他的九次尝试表明了他对击败对手的渴望，下半场的一次转身跑动几乎以一次特殊的单人进攻达到了高潮。哈维·阿隆索的体系，利用帕尔默与摩根·罗杰斯并肩作战，并在若奥·佩德罗的帮助下，帮助我们的 10 号球员接球。除了里斯·詹姆斯、乔什·阿奇姆彭和摩根·拉克鲁瓦之外，他控球的时间比所有切尔西外野手都多。当球在脚下时，帕尔默始终保持高效。他为若奥·佩德罗破纪录的进球（英超联赛首周末进球速度最快的进球）的助攻是帕尔默的三记关键传球之一，这一数字仅次于罗杰斯的五记传球。总的来说，帕尔默的传球完成率为88%，明显高于球队平均水平82%。很大一部分（14）也出现在最后三分之一，这凸显了他愿意冒险的意愿。帕尔默传球的力度和方向对于我们的第一个和第二个进球至关重要，而他自己的射门则显示了他在球门前的精准。角度很窄，所以他打算把球从贝恩德·莱诺的腿上滑过——并且成功了。帕尔默也不害怕做他的防守工作。他赢得了两次铲断并七次夺回控球权，其中三次是在进攻三区。事实证明，这些高失误对我们当晚的前两个进球起到了重要作用。帕尔默得到若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯的大力协助。这三人一共传球 20 次，表现出默契的迹象，这对未来来说是个好兆头——帕尔默的精英表现也是如此。接下来是周中联赛杯对阵卢顿镇的比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Bompastor confirms injured Chelsea trio to miss Real Sociedad game
news.title_zh: 庞帕斯特证实切尔西三人受伤将缺席皇家社会队的比赛
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed she will be without the services of three players for the first leg of our Champions League qualifying tie against Real Sociedad. The Blues head coach was joined by Lucy Bronze on Tuesday afternoon to answer the media’s questions ahead of our opening fixture of the 2026/27 campaign, which takes place at the Cherry Red Records Stadium in Wimbledon. It will be streamed for free live on the Chelsea Official App and website. Bompastor will hope to see her side establish a lead ahead of the second leg in Spain next week, but she will not be able to call upon Erin Cuthbert, Mayra Ramirez and Manaka Matsukubo. ‘We have a squad with almost everyone pretty available from pre-season,’ said Bompastor. ‘The ones who are not available are Erin Cuthbert, who had an injury in the last international break and she's recovering from that. We also have Manaka, who won't be available for this game, and Mayra as well, who won't be available for the game. ‘I don't think we could expect to see them for the second leg. I think it'll be a little bit longer, but it's difficult to put a timeframe on it. They are working really well and progressing as we want them to progress, but yeah, no timeframe. ‘Except from these three, everyone else is available.’ Bompastor expanded on Ramirez’s recovery following the serious hamstring injury she suffered this time last year, with the head coach explaining her absence on Wednesday is expected. ‘Mayra is recovering from not having played last season, and I think it's tough sometimes when you haven't played for the full season to be ready to compete. ‘It's part of her rehab plan. She's not quite ready, but we are working closely with her to make sure she returns on the pitch as fit as possible.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特确认，在欧冠资格赛对阵皇家社会的首回合比赛中，她将缺席三名球员的比赛。周二下午，蓝军主教练露西·青铜在我们 2026/27 赛季揭幕战（在温布尔登樱桃红唱片体育场举行）之前回答了媒体的问题。它将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上免费直播。邦帕斯托希望看到她的球队在下周西班牙第二回合比赛之前取得领先，但她将无法召唤艾琳·库斯伯特、迈拉·拉米雷斯和马纳卡·松久保。 “我们的阵容中几乎每个人都可以参加季前赛，”邦帕斯特说。 “缺席的是艾琳·库斯伯特，她在上次国际比赛中受伤，目前正在康复中。我们还有 Manaka，他将无法参加这场比赛，还有 Mayra，他也将无法参加这场比赛。 “我认为我们不会期望在第二回合看到他们。我认为会有点长，但很难确定时间表。他们工作得非常好，并且按照我们希望的那样取得进展，但是，是的，没有时间表。 “除了这三个人，其他人都可以上场。”邦帕斯特详细介绍了拉米雷斯去年这个时候腿筋严重受伤后的康复情况，主教练解释说，预计她将在周三缺席。 “梅拉正在从上赛季缺席的比赛中恢复过来，我认为，当你整个赛季都没有参加比赛时，要准备好参加比赛有时会很困难。 “这是她康复计划的一部分。她还没有完全准备好，但我们正在与她密切合作，以确保她尽可能健康地重返球场。

news.title: Carabao Cup third round draw: How to watch, possible opponents, ball numbers, fixture dates
news.title_zh: 卡拉宝杯第三轮抽签：如何观看、可能的对手、球数、比赛日期
news.body_en: Chelsea will discover our potential Carabao Cup third-round opponents on Wednesday evening, ahead of our involvement in the competition beginning against Luton Town the following day. The Blues begin this season's Carabao Cup campaign in the second round, when we host the Hatters at Stamford Bridge on Thursday night, with kick-off at 7.30pm. Before we take to the pitch for that game, the opponents awaiting the winner in the next round will already be known... The draw for the third round will take place on Wednesday 26 August, following the conclusion of Preston North End's second-round match against Everton. The draw will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK. We will bring you news of the draw on the Chelsea Official App and website as soon as it is known. The ball numbers for the Carabao Cup third-round draw will be announced on Wednesday 26 August. With the first of the second-round ties not to be played until Tuesday evening, all 44 of the other sides in the northern and southern section of the draw remain potential opponents for the third round. The nine Premier League teams competing in Europe will also enter the competition at the third-round stage. There is no north-south split to the draw from the third round on. The only restrictions to the draw are the eight teams competing in the UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League being seeded, meaning they cannot face each other, but are not guaranteed a home or away game. news.title: Joao Pedro on joining Palmer and Rogers in a ‘special’ front three
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗谈与帕尔默和罗杰斯一起组成“特殊”的前三名
news.body_en: Joao Pedro believes Chelsea showed our strength in an impressive opening game of what could be a great season for the Blues, especially with the Brazilian lining up alongside Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers in a new-look attack. The starting line-up for Xabi Alonso’s first competitive match as Chelsea manager featured a front three of Joao Pedro down the middle, supported either side by Palmer and summer signing Rogers. It proved a big hit on its first outing, with all three of those players getting on the scoresheet as we began our 2026/27 campaign with a 3-2 Premier League win away at neighbours Fulham on Monday evening. That front three is already causing plenty of excitement among the Blues supporters following its debut at Craven Cottage, and it seems to be shared by Joao Pedro after a performance full of movement and clever combinations. ‘Cole and Morgan, they are special players. Everyone knows that,’ said Joao Pedro after Chelsea’s winning start to the season. ‘I'm very grateful to play with them because I know if I make some runs, like yesterday, you know Cole and Morgan are going to give the ball to me, and I have to be ready to score. So it's very special for me to play with them. ‘I just try to enjoy and try to help my team in every game. Then this season, see what I get. I just try to score in every opportunity I have. ‘I’ve known Morgan since a long time ago because we played against each other,' added our new number nine. 'So when he joined the club, I knew it was very good for us because he's a very good player, and I think he can help us like he did yesterday. ‘I think now in the game, if we move a lot, it will be difficult for defenders to pick up one player, to stay with them. The manager led us to be free on the pitch, so we understand each other well. So this just helps us and hopefully it can happen many more times this season.’ The striker was quick to point out the victory was down to the whole team’s display, though, not just that of the front three. Furthermore, he believes it was a performance and result which laid down a marker for the season to come. ‘I think the whole group was very good, we tried to do our job,’ he continued. ‘We conceded two goals, but I think we did a great game. It's very difficult to play there and get the three points, and that is the important thing. ‘I think it's too early to say what our target is, but we need to go step-by-step. We have to focus on the Premier League and the cups. We have a lot of time to train as well, to know what the coach wants from us. Let's see in the end, hopefully we can achieve our targets. ‘I will enjoy this season, of course, because I think we can achieve higher things. When you play for Chelsea, you always need to look for that. Yesterday was a great game to show our power and hopefully we can continue like this in the rest of the season.’ Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗相信切尔西在一场令人印象深刻的首场比赛中展示了我们的实力，这对蓝军来说可能是一个伟大的赛季，特别是巴西人与科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯一起以全新的进攻方式排列。哈维·阿隆索作为切尔西主教练的第一场正式比赛的首发阵容中，若昂·佩德罗为中锋，两侧由帕尔默和夏季签约的罗杰斯支持。事实证明，它的首场比赛就取得了巨大成功，周一晚上，我们以 3-2 的英超联赛客场战胜邻居富勒姆，开始了 2026/27 年赛季，这三名球员都取得了进球。自从在克雷文小屋首次亮相后，这三名前锋就已经在蓝军球迷中引起了极大的兴奋，在充满运动和巧妙组合的表演后，若昂·佩德罗似乎也分享了这一点。 “科尔和摩根，他们是特别的球员。每个人都知道这一点，”若昂·佩德罗在切尔西取得赛季开局后说道。 “我非常感激能和他们一起比赛，因为我知道如果我像昨天一样跑动，你知道科尔和摩根会把球交给我，我必须准备好得分。所以和他们一起玩对我来说很特别。 “我只是努力享受每场比赛并努力帮助我的球队。那么这个赛季，看看我能得到什么。我只是尝试抓住每一个机会得分。 “我很久以前就认识摩根了，因为我们互相交手，”我们的新九号补充道。 “所以当他加入俱乐部时，我知道这对我们非常有好处，因为他是一名非常优秀的球员，我认为他可以像昨天一样帮助我们。 “我认为现在在比赛中，如果我们移动太多，后卫将很难抓住一名球员并与他们呆在一起。主教练带领我们在球场上自由自在，所以我们彼此很了解。所以这对我们很有帮助，希望这个赛季能发生更多次。”这位前锋很快指出，胜利取决于整个球队的表现，而不仅仅是前三名的表现。此外，他相信这是为即将到来的赛季奠定了基础的表现和结果。 “我认为整个团队都非常好，我们尽力做好我们的工作，”他继续说道。 “我们丢了两个球，但我认为我们踢了一场精彩的比赛。在那里打球并拿到三分是非常困难的，这才是重要的事情。 “我认为现在说我们的目标还为时过早，但我们需要一步一步来。我们必须专注于英超联赛和杯赛。我们也有很多时间训练，了解教练对我们的要求。让我们看看最后，希望我们能够实现我们的目标。 “当然，我会享受这个赛季，因为我认为我们可以取得更高的成就。当你为切尔西效力时，你总是需要寻找这一点。昨天是一场精彩的比赛，展示了我们的力量，希望我们能在本赛季余下的比赛中继续这样。接下来是我们周中对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Real Sociedad Women: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info

news.body_en: Chelsea Women play at the Cherry Red Records Stadium for the first time on Wednesday evening as we embark on our UEFA Women's Champions League campaign for the 2026/27 season. The Blues will play home domestic cup and any home European qualifying or league phase matches at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, while all Women’s Super League home matches will be at Stamford Bridge from the start of the campaign. Our third-place finish in the Women's Super League this season means we will play the qualifier against Real Sociedad to determine whether or not we enter the league phase of the Women's Champions League competition for 2026/27. The match will be played over two legs, with the second fixture at the Estadio Zubieta in San Sebastian scheduled for 2 September at 6pm. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Real Sociedad, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Real Sociedad takes place on Wednesday 26 August 2026 at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, with kick-off scheduled for 6.45pm UK time. Tickets are still available to purchase for Wednesday's match, but if you can't make it to the Cherry Red Records Stadium, then you can still watch our UWCL qualifier against Real Sociedad Women for free on the Chelsea website and Chelsea Official App. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Real Sociedad Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow through Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea won both of our pre-season friendlies, firstly with a 7-0 success against Auckland FC in New Zealand, followed up by a 3-0 victory over an A-League All-Stars side in Sydney. Meanwhile, Real Sociedad finished third in Liga F this season but in pre-season drew 1-1 with Logrono United and lost 2-0 to Portuguese side SCU Torreense. This is the first match in our history against Real Sociedad. Last season, we only faced Spanish opposition once, when Ellie Carpenter's stunning strike earned us a 1-1 draw against Barcelona in the UWCL league phase at Stamford Bridge. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!

news.title: Alonso explains how Palmer, Joao Pedro and Rogers can lead and inspire
news.title_zh: 阿隆索解释帕尔默、若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯如何领导和激励
news.body_en: Fulham discovered exactly what the attacking trio Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro and Morgan Rogers of are capable of at Craven Cottage on Monday evening. It was far less of a surprise for Blues manager Xabi Alonso, who believes the trio can inspire their Chelsea team-mates throughout the campaign. Palmer’s qualities are well known to Chelsea supporters; the 24-year-old has showcased them throughout his time at Stamford Bridge. Joao Pedro, who scored 20 goals and was named Player of the Season, has also demonstrated his talents on countless occasions. Rogers’ addition came earlier this summer and he has needed little time to adapt to life at Chelsea. Alonso deployed the three from the start against Fulham. Within 31 seconds, Palmer had teed up Joao Pedro to open the scoring. Rogers then opened his account in blue – sweeping home after good work from fellow signing Maxence Lacroix – and Joao Pedro returned the favour in the second period for Palmer, who netted his first of the campaign from an acute angle. Their goals proved decisive, with the Blues coming away from our west London neighbours with a 3-2 victory. And Alonso, while insisting he would not construct a team around the trio, emphasised what Palmer, Joao Pedro and Rogers can bring to the Chelsea side. He said: ‘They are going to be a very important part, but to build around them, no, it’s to build a team with them. They need to take responsibility, they need to lead the rest, they need to inspire the rest, because if they do great, the others will follow. 'We need to use them in the best possible situations and we need to have good links to reach them and they need to help the team be solid. The three of them, they have played for the team and scored, and that’s always important for the forwards.’ Palmer’s display on the banks of the Thames was particularly encouraging. For much of the previous campaign, he struggled with injury. It inhibited his game, with the England international admitting he wasn’t sure from one day to the next whether he would be in discomfort. Yet against Fulham, having had the summer off, Palmer appeared back to his fluid best. He weaved effortlessly beyond challenges and, while scoring and fashioning chances for team-mates, was also hugely impressive without the ball. Naturally, Alonso was pleased for the Blues’ No.10, and highlighted the influence Palmer can have when enjoying his football. He said: ‘I am very happy for Cole because I have really enjoyed seeing him play with this dynamism, with this freedom, with this responsibility, helping the team, and feeling important. We need that for the team. If Cole feels this way, we will have a better team and a better Chelsea. 'I am happy for him that he enjoyed his game, and you can see that.’ Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 周一晚上，富勒姆在克雷文小屋准确地发现了进攻三人组科尔·帕尔默、若奥·佩德罗和摩根·罗杰斯的能力。对于蓝军主教练哈维·阿隆索来说，这并不令人意外，他相信这三人能够在整个赛季激励他们的切尔西队友。帕尔默的品质为切尔西球迷所熟知。这位 24 岁的球员在斯坦福桥效力期间就展现了这些。打进20球并被评为赛季最佳球员的若奥·佩德罗也无数次展现了自己的才华。罗杰斯于今年夏天早些时候加盟，他几乎不需要时间来适应切尔西的生活。阿隆索在对阵富勒姆的比赛中从一开始就部署了三人。 31秒内，帕尔默就与若奥·佩德罗开球，首开纪录。随后，罗杰斯身着蓝色球衣，在队友马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 的出色表现后，横扫主场，而若奥·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 在下半场回报了帕尔默 (Palmer)，帕尔默以敏锐的角度攻入了本赛季的第一个进球。他们的进球起到了决定性的作用，蓝军以 3-2 的比分战胜了我们的西伦敦邻居。阿隆索虽然坚称自己不会围绕这三人组建一支球队，但强调了帕尔默、若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯可以给切尔西带来什么。他说：“他们将成为非常重要的一部分，但要围绕他们进行建设，不，是与他们一起建立一支团队。”他们需要承担责任，需要领导其他人，需要激励其他人，因为如果他们做得很好，其他人就会效仿。 “我们需要在最好的情况下使用他们，我们需要有良好的联系来联系他们，他们需要帮助球队变得稳固。他们三人为球队效力并进球，这对前锋来说总是很重要。”帕尔默在泰晤士河畔的表现尤其令人鼓舞。在上个赛季的大部分时间里，他都在与伤病作斗争。这抑制了他的比赛，这位英格兰国脚承认他每天都不确定自己是否会感到不适。然而在对阵富勒姆的比赛中，在经历了夏天的休息后，帕尔默似乎又回到了他流畅的最佳状态。他毫不费力地克服了挑战，在为队友得分和创造机会的同时，在无球情况下也给人留下了深刻的印象。自然，阿隆索对蓝军的 10 号球员感到高兴，并强调了帕尔默在享受足球时可以产生的影响力。他说：“我为科尔感到非常高兴，因为我真的很高兴看到他充满活力、自由、责任，帮助球队，并感到自己很重要。我们的团队需要这样的东西。如果科尔有这样的感觉，我们将拥有一支更好的球队和更好的切尔西。 “我为他感到高兴，他喜欢自己的比赛，你可以看到这一点。”接下来是我们周中对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Rooted in Rhythm: The Carnival Collection takes to the streets
news.title_zh: 植根于节奏：嘉年华系列走上街头
news.body_en: Launched today, a new Chelsea Football Club clothing range celebrates the heritage and energy of the iconic Notting Hill Carnival. The annual August event held in the north of the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea is Europe’s biggest street party and the leisurewear now on sale brings together the movement of our game, energy of the street and sound of the carnival that is celebrating its 60th anniversary this summer and takes place this coming weekend. Click to shop the Rooted in Rhythm range The collection proudly displays the Chelsea Roots emblem across the clothing. Chelsea Roots was launched in October 2025 with the mission of celebrating the cultural diversity across the club, building awareness of key issues and creating allyship with underrepresented backgrounds across football. The Rooted in Rhythm range marks a significant moment of that mission – allowing our strong ethos of inclusion to ripple from the centre of how the club operates, reaching our fanbase, our local communities and beyond. The Carnival Statement Jersey, Carnival Tee-Shirt, Carnival Sweatshirt and Carnival Track Jacket that make up the collection all showcase bold colouring, flowing lines and striking silhouettes travelling across the garments with typography and pattern unfolding from every angle. The Rooted in Rhythm Collection celebrates the rhythm of football and pulse of the neighbourhood as the unique history and colours of west London and carnival unite. It is available now, in perfect time for carnival, from the Megastore at Stamford Bridge and via our online store
news.body_zh: 今天推出的全新切尔西足球俱乐部服装系列旨在颂扬标志性诺丁山狂欢节的传统和活力。一年一度的 8 月活动在肯辛顿和切尔西皇家自治市北部举行，是欧洲最大的街头派对，现在出售的休闲服融合了我们游戏的动感、街头的活力和今年夏天庆祝其 60 周年并在下周末举行的嘉年华的声音。点击购买 Rooted in Rhythm 系列 该系列在服装上自豪地展示了 Chelsea Roots 标志。 Chelsea Roots 于 2025 年 10 月推出，其使命是庆祝整个俱乐部的文化多样性，提高对关键问题的认识，并与整个足球界的弱势群体建立联盟关系。 Rooted in Rhythm 系列标志着这一使命的一个重要时刻——让我们强烈的包容精神从俱乐部运营的中心蔓延开来，影响到我们的球迷群体、当地社区及其他地区。该系列的 Carnival Statement 球衣、Carnival T 恤、Carnival 运动衫和 Carnival 运动夹克均展现出大胆的色彩、流畅的线条和引人注目的轮廓，贯穿整个服装，版式和图案从各个角度展开。 Rooted in Rhythm 系列颂扬足球的节奏和社区的脉搏，将西伦敦和嘉年华的独特历史和色彩融为一体。现在，在狂欢节的最佳时间，可从斯坦福桥的 Megastore 和我们的在线商店购买

Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form found here during the selling period. Alternatively, supporters if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. The Emirates Stadium has up to six accessible spaces. Please contact the access team at access@chelseafc.com to reserve a space. Supporters will need to provide their car registration number along with the name of the Blue Badge holder and need to confirm they are happy for this and their email address/contact number to be passed to Arsenal. We have received an allocation of 3,003 tickets which includes an allocation of 25 non-ambulant and 25 personal assistant tickets. Ambulant tickets will be taken from the main allocation. The entire allocation for this fixture will be in digital form. This will be clearly marked on the online portal, so supporters can be aware that they are purchasing tickets in this format. Please note that away duplicate tickets can only be collected by supporters in the booking. Loyalty points will continue to be awarded for purchasing away tickets. The form will be active on Wednesday 2 September from 4pm, to access the form, please click here. Away ticket holders will be able to transfer their ticket up to six times per season. news.title: Omari Kellyman joins RC Strasbourg
news.title_zh: 奥马里·凯利曼加盟 RC 斯特拉斯堡
news.body_en: Omari Kellyman has completed a permanent transfer to Ligue 1 club RC Strasbourg. The attacking midfielder joined Chelsea from Aston Villa in the summer of 2024 and made his Premier League 2 debut for the Blues in August that year before injury curtailed his maiden season at Stamford Bridge. Kellyman enjoyed a successful loan spell at Cardiff City last campaign, helping the Bluebirds achieve promotion to the Championship. He then featured twice during Chelsea's tour of Australia and Asia this pre-season. We wish Omari every success as he begins a new chapter in his career.
news.body_zh: 奥马里·凯利曼已完成永久转会至法甲俱乐部 RC 斯特拉斯堡。这位攻击型中场球员于 2024 年夏天从阿斯顿维拉加盟切尔西，并于当年 8 月首次代表蓝军参加英超二级联赛，随后因伤缩短了他在斯坦福桥的处子赛季。凯利曼上赛季租借到卡迪夫城取得了成功，帮助蓝鸟队晋级英冠。随后，他在切尔西季前赛的澳大利亚和亚洲之旅中两次出场。我们祝愿奥马里在开启职业生涯新篇章时取得成功。

news.title: Berkeley-Agyepong joins Reading

news.body_en: Jeremiah Berkeley-Agyepong has joined Reading on a permanent basis. The teenager has been with Chelsea since Under-8 level, developing through the ranks, and was part our Under-15 side that won the Premier League Floodlit Cup. The winger featured for the Under-18 side during pre-season of 2024/25, and now moves to Berkshire for the next stage of his career. We wish Jeremiah well for the future.
news.body_zh: 耶利米·伯克利-阿吉蓬已永久加入雷丁。这位少年从U-8级别开始就在切尔西效力，在队伍中不断发展，并且是我们赢得英超泛光杯的U-15球队的一员。这位边锋在 2024/25 赛季季前赛期间为 18 岁以下球队效力，现在转会至伯克希尔，开启职业生涯的下一阶段。我们祝愿耶利米未来一切顺利。

news.title: Morgan Rogers: An enjoyable debut!
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯：令人愉快的首秀！
news.body_en: As debuts go, that Chelsea one from Morgan Rogers wasn’t half bad. After his switch to Stamford Bridge from Aston Villa, the England international would have been itching to hit the ground running. So scoring and helping the Blues to victory over Fulham will certainly have helped. Our No.17 restored our lead at Craven Cottage, after Joshua King had cancelled out Joao Pedro’s opener – which came after just 32 seconds. Cole Palmer, a close friend of Rogers, made it 3-1 just after the break, before Gonzalo Garcia reduced the deficit for Fulham. In the end, the Blues took all three points and Rogers – who played a key role alongside Palmer in a number ten role for Xabi Alonso’s side – believes this victory was a good start, but just that: a start. He believes there are still many gears for us to go up. ‘It was a great game to play in,’ Rogers said with a beaming smile. ‘Obviously to score and help the team win, that’s everything that I wanted from a debut. ‘I thought the quality of our play was excellent and it was so enjoyable out there. Fulham is a difficult place to come to, and they played really well, but we had that fight, that grit and I think we were the better team on the night. ‘For me, we deserved the win and I’m really happy with how the game went.’ Rogers would have been keen to make an impression at his new club, following his summer switch from Aston Villa, and having arrived later than some of his team-mates due to his involvement at the World Cup, the attacker believes the best version of him is still to come. ‘I didn’t feel that sharp towards the end, I was a bit tired and that’s why I came off for the last 10 minutes,’ admitted Morgan. ‘I’ve felt really good in pre-season but I’ve not had much of a break due to the World Cup, so I wanted to keep myself fresh. ‘Coming to a new team, you don't want to come in sluggish and off the pace, so I tried to keep myself in the best shape as possible and I’ve tried to get up to speed as quickly as I can. ‘I still think there are more gears to go, and I've got to try and find them as quickly as possible because the games are coming thick and fast. ‘But as I said, I felt good out there and I enjoyed it.’ Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Xabi Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 随着首秀的进行，摩根·罗杰斯在切尔西的那场比赛还不错。从阿斯顿维拉转投斯坦福桥后，这位英格兰国脚一直渴望开始新的征程。因此进球并帮助蓝军战胜富勒姆肯定会有所帮助。在约书亚·金 (Joshua King) 取消了若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 的首开纪录后，我们的 17 号队在克雷文小屋 (Craven Cottage) 恢复了领先优势——比赛仅用了 32 秒。罗杰斯的密友科尔·帕尔默在中场休息后将比分改写为3-1，随后贡萨洛·加西亚帮助富勒姆缩小了比分差距。最终，蓝军全取三分，罗杰斯——他与帕尔默一起在哈维·阿隆索的球队中担任十号球员，发挥了关键作用——相信这场胜利是一个良好的开端，但仅此而已：一个开始。他相信我们还有很多进步空间。 “这是一场很棒的比赛，”罗杰斯微笑着说道。 “显然，进球并帮助球队获胜，这就是我在首秀中想要的一切。 “我认为我们的比赛质量非常好，而且非常令人愉快。富勒姆是一个很难来到的地方，他们踢得非常好，但我们有那场战斗，那份勇气，我认为我们是当晚更好的球队。 “对我来说，我们配得上这场胜利，我对比赛的进展感到非常满意。”罗杰斯在夏季从阿斯顿维拉转会到新俱乐部后，他一直渴望给他的新俱乐部留下深刻的印象，并且由于参加世界杯而比他的一些队友晚到，这位攻击手相信他最好的版本还在后面。摩根承认，“到最后我感觉不是那么敏锐，我有点累，这就是我在最后10分钟下场的原因。” “我在季前赛中感觉非常好，但由于世界杯，我没有太多休息时间，所以我想让自己保持新鲜感。 “来到一支新球队，你不想表现得迟缓、跟不上节奏，所以我尽力让自己保持在最佳状态，并尽可能快地跟上节奏。 “我仍然认为还有更多的装备需要使用，我必须尽快找到它们，因为比赛即将到来，节奏很快。 “但正如我所说，我在那里感觉很好，我很享受。”接下来是我们周中对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛，以及哈维·阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！

news.title: Alonso: 'A very professional, solid performance with maturity'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“非常专业、稳定且成熟的表现”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes his Chelsea side produced a ‘very professional, solid performance with maturity’ to defeat Fulham in our Premier League opener and send the Chelsea supporters home from Craven Cottage with ‘happy faces’. Our first top-flight match of the campaign didn’t disappoint, with the west London derby against our neighbours testing the Blues in a variety of different ways. We broke the deadlock after just 32 seconds when Cole Palmer flicked a pass to Joao Pedro, who produced a deft finish to put us ahead. Fulham hit back midway through the opening period via Josh King, but Alonso’s side went into the interval ahead when Morgan Rogers struck on his debut. Cole Palmer then netted soon after the restart and, despite Fulham pulling a goal back through Gonzalo Garcia, we held on to claim all three points. After our win, Alonso highlighted several areas for improvement for his side. Yet the Chelsea manager was pleased to start his tenure with a win that showcased many different qualities we will need throughout the season ahead. ‘It feels very good, for sure,’ Alonso said in his post-match press conference. ‘We know how tough it is to win any Premier League game, and any away Premier League game. We prepared for an intense game, and I feel it was a very professional, solid performance, showing maturity and managing the difficult moments. ‘We got the lead quite early, had chances to score the second one, but after the equaliser we were through ten minutes when we didn’t choose the right moments to press and the movements. 'We corrected this well and in the second half, we felt comfortable without the ball, controlling the game. It was a performance to build for the future. There are things to improve for sure, but it was a good first day.’ Alonso added: ‘[It’s important] to manage in difficult moments, not to lose this emotional control. We know the Premier League is fantastic because sometimes the games are out of your hands. 'You don’t control them, so the players on the pitch need to know how to manage it – it’s as important as the tactics being right. It’s a process but today we went through good moments on that and we need to carry on that.’ After the full-time whistle was blown at Craven Cottage, Alonso and his players made their way over to the Chelsea faithful who had made the short trip down the Fulham Road to support their side. The Spaniard believes such moments are important in building a connection between those on the pitch and those in the stands. He said: ‘We are happy to play our first Premier League game of the season. My first official Premier League game with Chelsea felt great; in this stadium with our fans at the end, celebrating with them. ‘I had the feeling before kick-off that they were excited and they were hoping to see a good performance from the team, a serious one, and one they could see that we gave everything and fought for everything. I saw happy faces in the end and it’s important to create this bond. It’s early days, first game, but a good one.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索相信他的切尔西队在我们的英超揭幕战中打出了“非常专业、可靠且成熟的表现”，击败了富勒姆，并带着“幸福的面孔”送切尔西支持者从克雷文小屋回家。我们本赛季的第一场顶级比赛并没有让人失望，西伦敦德比对阵我们的邻居，以各种不同的方式考验着蓝军。仅仅 32 秒后，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 将球传给若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro)，后者灵巧的射门帮助我们取得领先，我们打破了僵局。富勒姆在开场中段通过约什·金进行反击，但阿隆索的球队在摩根·罗杰斯首次亮相时进入了中场休息。比赛重新开始后不久，科尔·帕尔默就进球了，尽管富勒姆通过冈萨洛·加西亚扳回一球，但我们还是保住了全部三分。在我们获胜后，阿隆索强调了他的球队需要改进的几个领域。然而，切尔西主帅很高兴以一场胜利开始他的任期，这场胜利展示了我们在未来整个赛季中需要的许多不同品质。 “当然，感觉非常好，”阿隆索在赛后新闻发布会上说道。 “我们知道赢得任何一场英超比赛以及任何客场英超比赛是多么困难。我们准备了一场激烈的比赛，我觉得这是一场非常专业、扎实的表现，展现了成熟度并处理了困难时刻。 “我们很早就取得了领先，有机会打进第二球，但在扳平比分后，我们在十分钟内没有选择正确的施压时机和动作。 “我们很好地纠正了这一点，在下半场，我们在无球的情况下感觉很舒服，控制了比赛。这是一场为未来打造的表演。肯定有一些事情需要改进，但这是一个很好的第一天。”阿隆索补充道：“[重要的是]在困难时刻进行管理，而不是失去情绪控制。我们知道英超联赛非常棒，因为有时比赛并不在你的掌控之中。 “你无法控制他们，所以球场上的球员需要知道如何管理——这与正确的战术同样重要。这是一个过程，但今天我们经历了美好的时刻，我们需要继续下去。”在克雷文小屋终场哨声吹响后，阿隆索和他的球员们走向了切尔西球迷，他们沿着富勒姆路进行了短暂的旅行来支持他们的球队。西班牙人相信这样的时刻对于在球场上和看台上建立联系非常重要。他说：“我们很高兴能够参加本赛季的第一场英超比赛。我与切尔西的第一场正式英超比赛感觉很棒；最后在这个体育场与我们的球迷一起庆祝。 “开球前我有一种感觉，他们很兴奋，希望看到球队有出色的表现，认真的表现，他们可以看到我们付出了一切，为一切而奋斗。我最终看到了幸福的面孔，建立这种联系很重要。现在还为时过早，第一场比赛，但是一场精彩的比赛。”

news.title: Match report: Fulham 2-3 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：富勒姆 2-3 切尔西
news.body_en: Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer all got on the scoresheet as Xabi Alonso's first game in charge of Chelsea ended in a 3-2 victory over west London neighbours Fulham at Craven Cottage. We made the ideal start to a half in which momentum swung back and forth. After just 32 seconds, Palmer flicked a pass into the path of Joao Pedro, who broke clear of the Fulham backline to score. Fulham equalised via Josh King in the 23rd minute, but Alonso's side responded and deservedly went into the interval ahead when, after excellent work from Maxence Lacroix, Rogers swept home on his debut. Palmer got his name on the scoresheet early into the second half, finishing off an attack which included contributions from Rogers and Joao Pedro. Yet Fulham hit back quickly through Gonzalo Garcia. The Blues had to dig in during the time that remained. It was about grit and determination – and we came through to ensure a winning start for Alonso and to our Premier League campaign. Marco Palestra and Moises Caicedo both missed the game with minor setbacks. So Alonso opted for a starting XI of Robert Sanchez, Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Levi Colwill, Malo Gusto, captain Reece James, Romeo Lavia, Jorrel Hato, Palmer, Rogers and Joao Pedro. Alonso anticipated a fiery west London derby – and the game lived up to his expectations. Yet we made the perfect start at Craven Cottage, with our opening goal arriving inside 35 seconds. There appeared little danger when a Fulham clearance was fired into the Chelsea half, but Lacroix won his header, the ball broke to Palmer, who flicked it deftly into the path of Joao Pedro. The Brazilian's first touch set him free of the Fulham defence and he lifted a fine finish over Leno. The goal was an instant settler and enabled the Blues attackers to begin expressing themselves. Rogers and Palmer linked neatly throughout the opening period and fashioned chances. The former saw a powerful shot blocked from the edge of the area; the latter forced Bernd Leno into a near-post save with a powerful drive. As the half progressed, Fulham started to wrestle momentum their way. King forced Sanchez into a smart reaction stop and, from the resulting corner, Cesar Palacios fired harmlessly over the crossbar. The home side did manage to pull level midway through the opening 45 minutes, as a neat exchange of passes down the Blues' left flank enabled King to break into the penalty area and drill a shot beyond Sanchez. A reaction was needed from Alonso's side. It quickly came. After seeing off a spell of Fulham pressure, we created several opportunities. Joao Pedro had the first, volleying a Palmer cross narrowly wide, before James tested Leno following a blocked Rogers shot. Lavia was next to be thwarted by the Fulham goalkeeper, who reacted well to deny the Belgian midfielder from close range following a well-worked short corner by the Blues. Deservedly, our efforts were eventually rewarded four minutes before the interval. After collecting possession on the half-turn, Palmer slipped a pass to Lacroix, who did excellently to trick his way beyond Jorge Cuenca and cross from the byline. The ball raced across the Fulham penalty area into the path of fellow summer signing Rogers, who swept home a finish to score on his Blues debut. There was time before the interval to push for a third, and the vibrant Palmer came close with a curled attempt from 20 yards that whistled narrowly wide. Yet, importantly, we went in ahead. Alonso will not have wanted his side to let up – the game felt in our hands – and Palmer picked up from where he left off in the opening period. One sublime run, in which he skipped beyond multiple challenges, almost enabled the Blues' No.10 to guide a finish into the far post. But moments later, there was no mistake. Our third goal started with Sanchez, who drove a pass forward toward Rogers. The England international flicked a header onto Joao Pedro, who bound into the Fulham half, waited for an overlap from Palmer and slipped in his fellow attacker. Palmer assessed his options, which were minimal, and opted to guide a shot between the legs of Leno. The Fulham goalkeeper was beaten, and the Blues had a third goal. Yet, as in the first half, Fulham pulled themselves back into the game by quickly reducing the deficit. The Blues didn't deal with a long ball forward and Timothy Castagne collected and fired a shot toward goal. Sanchez saved, but the rebound fell to Garcia, who reacted well to head home. The game became less frenetic as it progressed, with Alonso's side gaining greater control. It meant chances were harder to come by, although Joao Pedro did fire over an attempt from distance. With 25 minutes to play, the Blues manager turned to his bench. Pep Chavarria was introduced for his Blues debut for Hato, while Enzo Fernandez replaced Lavia. As the minutes ticked down, Fulham pushed hard for an equaliser. King came close again with another low effort that this time fizzed beyond the post, before a long ball forward presented Antonee Robinson with an opportunity to lob Sanchez. However, the USA international guided his attempt wide. With eight minutes remaining, Alonso made two more changes. Geovany Quenda and Estevao Willian were brought on; Rogers and Palmer were replaced. Sanchez had to stay alert in the closing stages, and the Blues goalkeeper reacted well to deny substitute Ryan Sessegnon at his near post. Four minutes of additional time were added. Yet just before they were entered, we had the ball in the back of the net. Quenda had a shot saved by Leno and Joao Pedro turned home the rebound, but the Portuguese winger was offside in the build-up. It mattered not, as Alonso's side saw out the contest to ensure we started the season with a victory and three points. It's a quick turnaround for the Blues, as we return to action on Thursday evening in the Carabao Cup, with League One Luton Town visiting Stamford Bridge. news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗、摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默均取得进球，哈维·阿隆索执教切尔西的第一场比赛最终在克雷文小屋以 3-2 战胜了西伦敦邻居富勒姆。我们在上半场取得了理想的开局，势头来回摇摆。仅仅32秒后，帕尔默就将球传给若昂·佩德罗，佩德罗突破富勒姆后防线得分。富勒姆在第 23 分钟通过约什·金 (Josh King) 扳平比分，但阿隆索的球队做出了回应，并理所当然地进入了中场休息，在马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 的出色表现后，罗杰斯 (Rogers) 在他的处子秀中横扫对手。帕尔默在下半场一开始就在进球表上名列前茅，他完成了一次进攻，其中包括罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗的贡献。然而富勒姆通过贡萨洛·加西亚迅速反击。蓝军必须在剩下的时间内继续努力。这是关于勇气和决心的——我们最终确保了阿隆索和我们的英超联赛的胜利开局。马科·帕莱斯特拉和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多都因小挫折缺席了比赛。因此阿隆索选择了首发阵容：罗伯特·桑切斯、乔什·阿奇姆蓬、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦、利维·科尔威尔、马洛·古斯托、队长里斯·詹姆斯、罗密欧·拉维亚、乔雷尔·哈托、帕尔默、罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗。阿隆索期待一场激烈的西伦敦德比——而这场比赛也没有辜负他的期望。然而我们在 Craven Cottage 取得了完美的开局，在 35 秒内就进球了。当富勒姆解围射入切尔西半场时，似乎没有什么危险，但拉克鲁瓦赢得了头球，皮球传给了帕尔默，后者巧妙地将球弹到了若昂·佩德罗的路径上。巴西人的第一次触球使他摆脱了富勒姆的防守，并以漂亮的射门超越了莱诺。这个进球瞬间定格，让蓝军进攻者开始表达自己的想法。罗杰斯和帕尔默在整个开场阶段就紧密配合并创造了机会。前者在禁区边缘看到一记强力射门被挡出；后者用强大的射门迫使贝恩德·莱诺近门柱扑救。随着上半场的进行，富勒姆开始争夺势头。金迫使桑切斯进行了一次巧妙的反击，塞萨尔·帕拉西奥斯在角球中的射门高出横梁，没有造成任何伤害。主队确实在开场45分钟中段扳平了比分，蓝军左翼的一次巧妙的传球让金突破到禁区并在桑切斯身后射门。阿隆索方面需要做出反应。它很快就来了。在摆脱了富勒姆的一段压力后，我们创造了几次机会。若奥·佩德罗（Joao Pedro）率先得分，帕尔默（Palmer）传中凌空抽射稍稍偏出，随后詹姆斯在罗杰斯（Rogers）射门被挡后测试莱诺（Leno）。拉维亚接下来被富勒姆门将挡出，富勒姆门将在蓝军漂亮的短角球后近距离挡出这位比利时中场球员。我们的努力最终在中场休息前四分钟得到了应有的回报。在半回合获得控球权后，帕尔默将球传给拉克鲁瓦，拉克鲁瓦出色地越过豪尔赫·昆卡并从底线传中。皮球飞过富勒姆禁区，飞向夏季新援罗杰斯，罗杰斯在蓝军首秀中攻入一球。中场休息前还有时间争取第三个机会，充满活力的帕尔默在 20 码外尝试一记弧线球，稍稍偏出。然而，重要的是，我们走在了前面。阿隆索不会希望他的球队放松下来——比赛感觉就在我们的手中——而帕尔默则从开场阶段结束的地方接续了比赛。在一次精彩的跑动中，他跳过了多项挑战，几乎让蓝军的10号将球射入远门柱。但过了一会儿，没有任何错误。我们的第三个进球是由桑切斯开始的，他向前传球给罗杰斯。这位英格兰国脚将头球传给若奥·佩德罗，佩德罗跳入富勒姆半场，等待帕尔默的重叠，然后滑入他的队友攻击手。帕尔默评估了他的选择，但选择了在莱诺的两腿之间引导射门。富勒姆门将被打，蓝军取得第三个进球。然而，和上半场一样，富勒姆迅速缩小比分差距，重新拉回比赛。蓝军没有应对长传前锋，蒂莫西·卡斯塔涅接球射门。桑切斯扑救，但篮板球落到了加西亚身上，加西亚反应良好，头球破门。 随着比赛的进行，比赛变得不再那么激烈，阿隆索的球队获得了更大的控制权。这意味着机会更难获得，尽管若奥·佩德罗确实从远处射门。比赛还剩 25 分钟时，蓝军主帅转向替补席。佩普·查瓦里亚 (Pep Chavarria) 代表哈托 (Hato) 上演蓝军首秀，而恩佐·费尔南德斯 (Enzo Fernandez) 取代拉维亚 (Lavia)。随着时间的流逝，富勒姆努力扳平比分。金再次差点射出一记低射，但这次却超出了门柱，随后一名长传前锋为安东尼·罗宾逊提供了吊射桑切斯的机会。然而，这位美国国脚的射门却偏向外侧。还剩八分钟时，阿隆索又做出了两次改变。乔瓦尼·昆达和埃斯特瓦·威廉上场；罗杰斯和帕尔默被替换。桑切斯在最后阶段必须保持警惕，蓝军门将反应良好，在近门柱挡出了替补球员瑞恩·塞塞尼翁的射门。增加了四分钟的额外时间。然而就在他们进场之前，我们把球打进了球网。昆达的射门被莱诺扑出，若昂·佩德罗将篮板球打进，但葡萄牙边锋在进攻中越位。这并不重要，因为阿隆索的球队见证了这场比赛，确保我们以一场胜利和三分开始了新赛季。对于蓝军来说，这是一个快速的转变，我们将在周四晚上的联赛杯中重返赛场，联赛第一的卢顿镇将客场挑战斯坦福桥。切尔西：桑切斯； Acheampong、拉克鲁瓦、科尔威尔；古斯托 (内托 76)、詹姆斯 (c)、拉维亚 (费尔南德斯 65)、哈托 (查瓦里亚 65)；帕尔默（Quenda 82）、罗杰斯（Estevao 82）、若昂·佩德罗切尔西替补：彭德斯、巴科、吉滕斯、维尔贝克进球者：若昂·佩德罗 1、罗杰斯 41、帕尔默 49 黄牌：科尔威尔 5、拉维亚 12、詹姆斯 75 news.title: Xabi Alonso explains Marco Palestra and Moises Caicedo absences against Fulham
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索解释马科·帕莱斯特拉和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多缺席对阵富勒姆的比赛
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has confirmed why Chelsea duo Marco Palestra and Moises Caicedo are not in the matchday squad for our Premier League opener against Fulham. Our top-flight campaign begins a stone’s throw away from Stamford Bridge, with Alonso’s first competitive game as Chelsea manager taking place at Craven Cottage, the home of our west London neighbours. The Spaniard has named a starting XI that includes Robert Sanchez, Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Levi Colwill, Malo Gusto, Reece James, Romeo Lavia, Jorrel Hato, Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro, but the absence of Palestra and Caicedo is noteworthy. Alonso faced the media pre-game and was asked why the duo missed out. He replied: ‘They had minor setbacks during the week, so they were not fit to play tonight. New faces debut for us, Morgan and Max, and they are going to play important roles through the year.’ After a pre-season campaign that saw matches played in Australia and Asia, in addition to a friendly against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge, Alonso gets the chance to oversee a game which has points at stake. And the new Blues manager is looking forward to the contest. He said: 'Everyone is excited in the building and in the team. It’s great that after a long pre-season we are where we want to be. First Premier League game and I’m really happy to be involved. 'It’s going to be emotional for everyone, given it’s our first game. It’s a derby and the excitement of the crowd will be there. So we will need to manage the game.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索已经证实了为什么切尔西二人组马科·帕莱斯特拉和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多没有出现在我们对阵富勒姆的英超揭幕战的比赛阵容中。我们的顶级联赛赛季将在距斯坦福桥仅一箭之遥的地方开始，阿隆索作为切尔西主教练的第一场正式比赛将在我们伦敦西部邻居的家克雷文小屋举行。西班牙人已经任命了首发十一人，其中包括罗伯特·桑切斯、乔什·阿奇姆蓬、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦、列维·科尔威尔、马洛·古斯托、里斯·詹姆斯、罗密欧·拉维亚、乔雷尔·哈托、科尔·帕尔默、摩根·罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗，但值得注意的是帕莱斯特拉和凯塞多的缺席。阿隆索赛前面对媒体，被问及为何两人缺席。他回答说：“他们在这一周遇到了一些小挫折，所以他们今晚不适合参加比赛。新面孔摩根和马克斯首次亮相，他们将在这一年中扮演重要角色。在经历了在澳大利亚和亚洲进行的季前赛，以及在斯坦福桥对阵皇家社会的友谊赛之后，阿隆索有机会监督一场关键的比赛。新任蓝军主帅也对这场比赛充满期待。他说：“大楼里和团队里的每个人都感到兴奋。经过漫长的季前备战后，我们达到了我们想要达到的目标，这真是太好了。第一场英超比赛，我很高兴能够参与其中。 “考虑到这是我们的第一场比赛，每个人都会很激动。这是一场德比，球迷们都会兴奋不已。所以我们需要管理比赛。

news.title: Lola Brown: My journey to Chelsea
news.title_zh: 洛拉·布朗：我的切尔西之旅
news.body_en: When you talk to Chelsea Academy graduate Lola Brown, it’s difficult to believe that she’s still only 18. She speaks with maturity well beyond her years, but still has a youthful glint in her eye. It’s clear she’s hungry, and with a calm head to match, she’s ideally placed to soak up everything she needs to learn from the senior professionals at Chelsea. That, alongside her natural ability on the pitch, means the reasons for offering Brown a three-year contract extension are evident. During the domestic Treble-winning campaign of 2024/25, she made her senior debut for the Blues, and after a loan spell at Crystal Palace last season, she’s loving life back in SW6. ‘Football means absolutely everything to me,’ she smiles. ‘When you wake up in the morning, you have something to strive towards. It's always given me a purpose, and I'm also very competitive, so it drives me to want to win. ‘It’s more than just the matchday, though. It's the day-to-day. Every single day you're going for something. That’s why it means everything.’ Perhaps part of the reason for Brown’s mature outlook is the experience of a childhood spent on foreign shores. She began her school life in Malta, where she remained until the age of eight, before her parents returned to England. Two years later, the youngster secured a place in the Chelsea Academy. ‘My parents just went over to Malta, sort of like a getaway,’ she explains. ‘They went for two years, but ended up staying for 14 because they loved it so much. I was born there and then lived there till I was eight. I actually absolutely loved it there. Malta is a massive part of who I am; it’s where I grew up. I owe a lot to Malta, in terms of my early stages and making me who I am as a person. ‘My whole family loves sports. We were all really competitive and driven when I was young, which massively shaped me as a person. The people I had around me in those early years really embedded good morals that I want to live by. ‘I always played football with my brother in the garden in Malta. He’s six years older than me, but when I'd beat him 1-v-1, he'd just pick me up! I would get a bit annoyed because I'm not sure that's part of the rules... ‘At the age of four or five I started playing football at school. My school coach also ran the team in Malta, so then I joined a boys' team pretty soon afterwards. I started school in Malta, then we moved to England. ‘When I came over here, I joined another boys’ team, and I played with them for a while, too,' adds Lola. 'I joined the Academy at Under-12 level, but I was only 10. I was playing against Chelsea with my boys’ team, and that's where they picked me up. Playing on a boys' team is always hard, but I also think it helped me to grow. I enjoyed the challenge.’ They say it takes a village to raise a child, and it’s certainly the same when it comes to developing a young footballer into a professional. Brown credits Leanne Champ at the Chelsea Academy and is also grateful to her family for the sacrifices they made when she was growing up as a young footballer. ‘Leanne helped me throughout the whole Academy,’ Brown continues. ‘She helped me progress as a player and developed my confidence. ‘It was all worth it when I signed my first professional contract two years ago. It was massive. I think that's when you realise it's more than just football. So many people have sacrificed so much for you to get to that moment. ‘My mum massively helped me to get where I am today. She would drive me literally every day. I lived far away, so it'd be like a four-hour round trip every single day. Mum did the driving, but even my siblings were at home making dinner for themselves so I could live my dream. It means so much. Still only 18, Brown can remember looking up to Chelsea players past and present. One of those heroes – Lucy Bronze – is now her Blues team-mate, a dream scenario for the enthusiastic young player. She recalls watching Bronze score the winner for Manchester City in the 2016 Women’s League Cup final. Brown even walked out alongside Willian as a mascot at Stamford Bridge before making her debut on the same pitch a few years later, with a few wise words in her ear from head coach Sonia Bompastor. ‘My two heroes were Bronze and Fran Kirby when I was growing up,’ she says. ‘A match that always comes into mind was my first ever women's match I went to, and I saw Lucy Bronze score a header in a final. I was a pretty big fan. Now I’m playing with her, which is a bit surreal. I felt a bit like that with Fran Kirby as well because she was here for a bit when I trained with her, and I’d always idolised her. ‘My debut against Celtic in the Champions League was so surreal, especially because it was at Stamford Bridge. I remember warming up and looking at the pitch, because it was the first time I'd been on it except for when I was really young as a mascot. I walked out with Willian on that day. ‘Even when I was warming up, I was thinking, "Oh, I could actually come on here at Stamford Bridge." So when I got subbed on, I was just super excited. The nerves disappeared, and it was more just excitement to get on the pitch. ‘I think Sonia said to enjoy it and take in the moment and to be brave and confident on the pitch.’ Wise words indeed for a player who has her whole future ahead of her and is here to stay at Chelsea.
news.body_zh: 当你与切尔西学院毕业生 Lola Brown 交谈时，很难相信她还只有 18 岁。她说话的成熟度远远超出了她的年龄，但她的眼中仍然闪烁着青春的光芒。很明显，她很饥饿，而且头脑冷静，她处于理想的位置，可以从切尔西的高级专业人士那里学到她需要学习的一切。再加上她在球场上的天赋，意味着为布朗提供三年续约的理由是显而易见的。在2024/25赛季国内三冠王赛季中，她首次代表蓝军成年队亮相，上赛季租借到水晶宫后，她又回到了SW6，热爱生活。 “足球对我来说绝对意味着一切，”她微笑着说。 “当你早上醒来时，你就会有一些值得奋斗的目标。它总是给我一个目标，而且我也很有竞争力，所以它驱使我想要获胜。 “不过，这不仅仅是比赛日。这是日复一日的。每一天你都在追求某些东西。这就是为什么它意味着一切。”也许布朗成熟的观点的部分原因是在外国海岸度过的童年经历。她在马耳他开始了她的学校生活，直到八岁，她的父母才返回英国。两年后，这位年轻人在切尔西青训学院获得了一席之地。 “我的父母刚刚去了马耳他，有点像度假，”她解释道。 “他们去了两年，但最终呆了 14 年，因为他们非常喜欢这里。我出生在那里，然后在那里住到八岁。我实际上非常喜欢那里。马耳他是我的重要组成部分；这是我长大的地方。就我的早期阶段和造就现在的我而言，我非常感谢马耳他。 “我全家都热爱运动。当我年轻的时候，我们都非常有竞争力和动力，这极大地塑造了我的性格。早年我周围的人确实蕴含着我想要遵循的良好道德。 “我总是和我的兄弟在马耳他的花园里踢足球。他比我大六岁，但当我一对一击败他时，他就会接我！我会有点生气，因为我不确定这是规则的一部分……“四五岁的时候，我开始在学校踢足球。我的学校教练也在马耳他管理球队，所以很快我就加入了男子球队。我在马耳他开始上学，然后我们搬到了英国。 “当我来到这里时，我加入了另一个男孩队，我也和他们一起玩了一段时间，”洛拉补充道。 “我加入了 12 岁以下级别的青训学院，但当时我只有 10 岁。我当时正在和我的男孩队对阵切尔西，他们就是在那里挑选了我。在男子球队踢球总是很困难，但我也认为这帮助了我成长。我喜欢这个挑战。”他们说养育一个孩子需要整个村庄的努力，而将一名年轻足球运动员培养成职业球员当然也是如此。布朗赞扬了切尔西青训学院的莉安·钱普，也感谢她的家人在她作为一名年轻足球运动员成长过程中所做出的牺牲。 “莉安在整个学院帮助了我，”布朗继续说道。 “她帮助我作为一名球员取得进步并增强了我的信心。 “两年前，当我签下第一份职业合同时，一切都是值得的。它是巨大的。我想那时你就会意识到这不仅仅是足球。为了你到达那一刻，很多人牺牲了很多。 “我的妈妈为我提供了巨大的帮助，让我取得了今天的成就。她几乎每天都会开车送我。我住的地方比较远，每天来回都要四个小时。妈妈负责开车，但就连我的兄弟姐妹也在家里为自己做饭，这样我就可以实现我的梦想。这意味着很多。年仅 18 岁的布朗还记得他对过去和现在的切尔西球员的仰慕之情。其中一位英雄——露西·青铜——现在是她的蓝军队友，这对这位热情的年轻球员来说是一个梦想的场景。她回忆起在 2016 年女子联赛杯决赛中观看铜牌为曼城攻入致胜球的情景。布朗甚至作为吉祥物与威廉一起走出斯坦福桥，几年后，她在同一球场上首次亮相，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特在她耳边说了几句睿智的话。 “在我成长的过程中，我的两个英雄是布隆兹和弗兰·柯比，”她说。 “我脑海中总是浮现出一场比赛，这是我参加的第一场女子比赛，我看到露西·青铜在决赛中头球破门。我是一个非常大的粉丝。 现在我和她一起玩，这有点超现实。我对弗兰·柯比也有类似的感觉，因为当我和她一起训练时，她在这里呆过一段时间，而且我一直很崇拜她。 “我在冠军联赛中对阵凯尔特人队的首秀是如此超现实，特别是因为那是在斯坦福桥。我记得热身时看着球场，因为这是我第一次踏上球场，除了我很小的时候作为吉祥物的时候。那天我和威廉一起出去了。 “即使在我热身的时候，我也在想，‘哦，我实际上可以来到斯坦福桥。’”所以当我替补上场时，我非常兴奋。紧张感消失了，更多的是上场时的兴奋。 “我认为索尼娅说过要享受这一切，把握当下，在球场上要勇敢和自信。”对于一个拥有整个未来并留在切尔西的球员来说，这句话确实明智。

news.title: Lola Brown signs new contract
news.title_zh: 洛拉·布朗签署新合同
news.body_en: Chelsea midfielder Lola Brown has put pen to paper on a new contract, committing her future to the club until at least 2029. Having joined the Blues during the 2019/20 season, she agreed her first professional contract in November 2024, aged 17. On signing her new deal, Brown said: ‘It feels amazing. I’m super proud. It’s a club I always wanted to sign a professional contract with, so to sign my second one is an amazing feeling. ‘Chelsea have developed me from a young age, and I can see how much I have developed here and how much I continue to develop. ‘Being around this environment and learning from the best helps you progress as a player. Now I want to win as many trophies as possible, and on a personal level I want to score my first professional goal as a Chelsea player.’ Brown was named Chelsea Women’s Academy Under-18 Player of the Year for the 2023/24 campaign. The teenager made her senior debut for the club the following season, coming on against Celtic in the Women’s Champions League group stage. She earned further minutes in a win over Twente, and towards the end of that domestic Treble-winning campaign, made her WSL debut in a victory at Tottenham. A loan move was next on the agenda for Brown as she moved across London to join Crystal Palace in WSL2. An injury hampered her progress in the first half of the campaign, but she returned to action in January and played a key role in the Eagles’ promotion back to the top flight. Palace went into a key clash with Portsmouth knowing that a win would guarantee automatic promotion. With the scores level at half-time, Brown was brought on and provided three assists to help secure an eventual 6-1 victory. She was voted the Player of the Match for her efforts. On the international stage, Brown has represented England at Under-16, Under-17, Under-19 and Under-20 levels, and has been called up to the Young Lionesses squad for September's U-20 Women's World Cup.
news.body_zh: 切尔西中场球员洛拉·布朗已经签署了一份新合同，将她的未来承诺到俱乐部至少到 2029 年。在 2019/20 赛季加入蓝军后，17 岁的她于 2024 年 11 月签订了第一份职业合同。在签署新合同时，布朗表示：“感觉棒极了。”我非常自豪。这是我一直想与之签订职业合同的俱乐部，所以签下我的第二份合同是一种奇妙的感觉。 “切尔西从小就培养了我，我可以看到我在这里发展了多少，并且还在继续发展。 “在这样的环境中并向最好的球员学习可以帮助你作为一名球员取得进步。现在我想赢得尽可能多的奖杯，在个人层面上，我想打进作为切尔西球员的第一个职业进球。”布朗被评为 2023/24 赛季切尔西女子学院 18 岁以下球员年度最佳球员。这名少年在接下来的赛季中首次代表俱乐部成年队亮相，在女子冠军联赛小组赛对阵凯尔特人队的比赛中登场。她在战胜特温特的比赛中赢得了更多的上场时间，并在国内三冠王赛季结束时在托特纳姆热刺队的胜利中完成了她的 WSL 处子秀。布朗的下一个议程是租借，因为她穿过伦敦加盟 WSL2 的水晶宫。上半程的伤病阻碍了她的进步，但她在一月份重返赛场，并在老鹰队重返顶级联赛的过程中发挥了关键作用。水晶宫在与朴茨茅斯的一场关键比赛中知道，一场胜利将确保自动晋级。半场战罢，布朗上场并送出3次助攻，帮助球队最终以6-1获胜。由于她的努力，她被评为本场最佳球员。在国际舞台上，布朗曾代表英格兰参加U-16、U-17、U-19和U-20级别的比赛，并被征召入青年狮队参加9月的U-20女子世界杯。

news.title: Fan Engagement Plan published for 2026/27 season
news.title_zh: 2026/27 赛季球迷参与计划公布
news.body_en: Today, we are delighted to launch the latest edition of our Fan Engagement Plan for the 2026/27 season. As part of the Premier League’s Fan Engagement Standard, the plan highlights the work achieved last season in engaging with our supporters and the vision for the season ahead to ensure regular dialogue with our fans. The plan is a requirement for all Premier League clubs, designed to provide clear outcomes and objectives for our strategic vision to engage with supporters. It highlights the events and campaigns organised with various supporter groups including the Chelsea Supporters’ Trust, Chelsea Pride, Chelsea Muslim Supporters Group and the Chelsea Jewish Supporters Group. As well as this, the plan sets out the key role of the Fan Advisory Board in ensuring that supporters engage with the club on long-term strategic initiatives that impact fan sentiment. Head of supporter relations Michael Cornall said, ‘We are delighted to publish our Fan Engagement Plan for the 2026/27 season. ‘We want fans to be able to engage at all levels of the club and welcome their views and input. We will continue to facilitate dialogue via multiple channels and forums as set out in the Fan Engagement Plan.’ Click to view the 2026/27 Fan Engagement Plan

news.title: Chelsea Diary: The week we've all been waiting for
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：我们一直在等待的一周
news.body_en: The 2026/27 campaign begins in earnest for our two senior teams this week, with Chelsea men's team facing three fixtures in the space of seven days and Sonia Bompastor's side getting underway in Europe. Xabi Alonso's Chelsea will play our first match of the Premier League campaign, while the Blues will hope a Carabao Cup run also starts this week. It is a Women's Champions League qualifying clash for Bompastor's team, and there are four matches across the Cobham Next Gen, Women's Under-21s and men's Under-18s this week. Add in a couple of notable anniversaries from the club's recent history, and there is plenty for Blues supporters to look forward to over the next seven days. The new Premier League season begins for Chelsea this evening with a short trip across west London to face Fulham at Craven Cottage. The Blues kick off the 2026/27 league campaign away from home, with the fixture selected as the opening Monday Night Football match of the season on Sky Sports. As always, supporters can follow all the action live in our Fulham vs Chelsea Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, where you'll find minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary. Fans can also experience the matchday through the new Chelsea Official App, where we will have an ongoing story from Craven Cottage, and we will of course bring you the latest team news, match report and reaction from just down the road. Today also marks the anniversary of Cesar Azpilicueta joining Chelsea in 2012. The Spaniard went on to become one of the most decorated captains in the club's history, lifting the Champions League, Europa League, Premier League, FA Cup and Club World Cup during an outstanding spell in blue. You can learn more about the bona-fida Blues legend here. After hearing from Alonso and his players after the Fulham match, attention quickly turns to the next challenge, with the men's team's preparations beginning for Thursday night's Carabao Cup second-round tie against Luton Town at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea enter the competition in round two and we will bring you the latest from Cobham ahead of that one. There is competitive action for our Cobham Next Gen side as they travel to Bristol Rovers in the EFL Cup for a 7pm kick-off. The young Blues will be looking to continue their development against senior opposition, with the competition providing another valuable opportunity for players on their pathway from Academy football towards the first team. Supporters can follow events with minute-by-minute updates in our Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, while those in the UK can watch the match on Sky Sports+. Blues supporters can also look forward to hearing from Chelsea Women head coach Bompastor ahead of our Champions League qualifying round first-leg tie at Stamford Bridge. You can watch the head coach's press conference live on the Chelsea Official App and website from 3pm. It's a European matchday for the Blues! The first leg sees us host Real Sociedad at Cherry Red Records Stadium, the home of AFC Wimbledon. Tickets are still available and can be purchased here from just £6 for under-16s and £12 for adults. For those further afield who can't make it to the ground, we will bring you the action as it happens via our Chelsea Women vs Real Sociedad Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. The fixture represents the first competitive match of the new season for Bompastor's side as they seek to secure a place in the competition proper. Academy football is also on the agenda as Chelsea Under-18s travel to Wolverhampton Wanderers in the Premier League Cup at 2pm. Watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription on the Chelsea Official App and website. The men's team are back in action just three days after our league opener as Luton Town visit Stamford Bridge in the Carabao Cup. Cup competitions have delivered many memorable moments throughout Chelsea's history and the Blues will be looking to begin another campaign in the competition with a victory. Progression into the next round will be the objective as competitive football returns to the Bridge for the first time this season. Supporters can follow all the build-up, match coverage and post-match reaction across the club's official channels. Live audio commentary and minute-by-minute updates will be available in the Chelsea vs Luton Town Match Centre. Focus turns to Sunday's Premier League clash with Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge. Alonso will address the media ahead of the match, with supporters able to hear from the manager on the Chelsea Official App and website. Friday also marks the anniversary of Willian joining Chelsea in 2013. The Brazilian quickly became a fan favourite during seven years at the club, winning two Premier League titles, the Europa League, FA Cup and League Cup while making more than 300 appearances in blue. There is more Academy action to enjoy this weekend, with Chelsea Under-18s back in U18 Premier League action at home to Reading at 11am. As with all eligible Academy fixtures, it will be available to watch live on the Chelsea Official App and website with a CFC+ subscription. Fans can find out more about CFC+ and available packages via our subscriptions page. We will also hear from Alonso and the Blues players as they put the finishing touches to preparations for the visit of Brighton. A busy week concludes as Premier League football returns to the Bridge, with Chelsea hosting a Brighton & Hove Albion side who beat Aston Villa 4-0 on Sunday. Hospitality tickets are still available here, and supporters can follow all the action live in our Chelsea vs Brighton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, where you'll find minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary. Fans can also experience the matchday through the new Chelsea Official App, where we will have an ongoing story from the Bridge. Chelsea Women Under-21s are also back in action. They started the season with an 8-0 win over London City Lionesses and on Sunday welcome Crystal Palace Under-21s.
